shortDescription: Three wallets suspected to belong to the same whale withdrew 211,430 HYPE from Hyperliquid within minutes, according to Onchain Lens. According to Odaily, the wallets withdrew 81,340 HYPE, 78,090 HYPE, and 52,000 HYPE, and are now transferring HYPE between Hyperliquid and related addresses.
